Instructions for the person testing in Word

1. In Word, right-click the contents above and choose Update Field, then Update entire table.

2. Add a comment on any word, and reply to it.

3. Turn on Track Changes, change a word in the paragraph above, and turn it off again.

4. Add a numbered list of your own, then use Restart at 1 and Set Numbering Value on one item.

5. Save As: word-interop.docx (Word Document format).
